objects.layers: I_{sigma,1}, I_{sigma,2}, I_{sigma,3} on common component universe, with pairwise disjoint survivor sides R1,R2,R3
objects.incidence_union: I_sigma has left side S_sigma=R1 disjoint_union R2 disjoint_union R3, right side residual Y0 components, and edge set union_i E(I_{sigma,i})
objects.common_layout_parameter: COMMON_LAYER_MIM(T)=max over cuts e of T and i in {1,2,3} of mim_{I_{sigma,i}}(e)

phase_A0.name: COMMON_LAYER_TO_UNION_WIDTH_REDUCTION
phase_A0.theorem_target: For every common decomposition T, COMMON_LAYER_MIM(T) <= mim_{I_sigma}(T) <= 3*COMMON_LAYER_MIM(T).
phase_A0.purpose: Replace the three-layer synchronization-width question by one ordinary mim-width question on I_sigma, up to factor 3.

phase_A1.name: COMMON_LAYOUT_EXISTENCE_CONSTRUCTION
phase_A1.target: Construct in polynomial time a branch decomposition T of I_sigma with mim-width <= q(|S|), or produce a source-valid obstruction.
phase_A1.forbidden: Do not call an optimizer/recognizer for mim-width or sim-width.
phase_A1.imported_warning: Global width recognition is NP-hard even under small constant-width promises.

phase_A1_import_subcheck.name: SIMULTANEOUS_PARAMETER_DIRECT_TRANSFER
phase_A1_import_subcheck.target: Check whether the exact three-layer source system has constant simultaneous-C number over a bounded-mim base class with a constructive representation.
phase_A1_import_subcheck.ceiling: The 2026 simultaneous-parameter theorem is usable only after such a representation is proved.

phase_B.name: COMMON_LAYOUT_D1_BOUND
phase_B.conditional_on: a common decomposition T with per-layer width <=w
theorem_target: For each layer i and actual color c, processed vertices in R_i of color c have at most n^{O(w)} 1-neighborhood equivalence classes across any cut.
The joint signature over 3 layers x 4 actual colors has at most n^{O(12w)} values per coarse class.
Across at most B(s) coarse classes, the crude joint bound is n^{O(12*w*B(s))}.
phase_B.firewall: This is a counting/compression theorem, not yet a source-sufficiency theorem.

phase_C.name: SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY
phase_C.target: Prove or falsify that equal joint d=1 signature plus seed-bounded source state preserves exactly future extendability, component feasibility information needed by the repair, list/source constraints, and polynomial reconstruction.
